scope: Canonical source records required by the P4 acceptance fixtures. Other receipt URLs remain links until a stable record is curated.

records.title: Banking on Climate Chaos 2026
records.scope: The seventeenth Banking on Climate Chaos report, whose league table gives fossil-fuel financing for each of the world's 65 largest banks, for 2025 and for the five years from 2021.
records.method: The report states its own method: financing is attributed to lead arrangers of corporate lending and underwriting, with the dataset and methodology FAQ published alongside it.
limits: This record supports the named fossil-financing figures, not unrelated banking criteria.
The table covers 65 banks. A bank absent from it is unmeasured here, not clean.
Every figure cited here was read from the report itself, not from a press summary of it.

records.title: Global Alliance for Banking on Values becomes first financial network to endorse the Fossil Fuel Non-Proliferation Treaty at COP29
records.scope: The Treaty initiative's own announcement, naming the 25 Global Alliance for Banking on Values member banks that endorsed it at COP29.
limits: The announcement does not provide a research method. It is a list of who signed.
This record supports the named environment claims, not fees or account access.
It is also the source for an absence: a values-based bank not on this list did not endorse the Treaty, which is a narrower fact than a poor environmental record.
